Successor

Successor moves from one natural number to the next.

editorialnumber-theory · arithmetic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Successor moves from one natural number to the next.

EXACT

The compact statement

A Peano-style successor S:N→N is injective and never maps any n to 0.

Example

S(0) is written 1; S(S(0)) is written 2.

Boundary / caveat

The properties of successor come from the chosen arithmetic axioms.
